## Summary

I implemented the `text_transform` MCP server in `server.mjs` with two exported functions:

### `listTools()`
Returns the `text_transform` tool with a strict JSON schema:
- `text` (string, required)
- `mode` (string enum: `uppercase`, `lowercase`, `slug`, required)
- `trim` (boolean, optional)
- `additionalProperties: false` to enforce the argument contract

### `callTool(name, args)`
Performs thorough validation and transformation:

**Validation (rejects invalid/extra inputs & unknown tools):**
- Throws `Unknown tool:` for any tool name other than `text_transform`
- Rejects non-object arguments
- Rejects any unexpected/extra argument keys
- Requires `text` to be a string
- Requires `mode` to be one of the three allowed values
- Requires `trim` (if provided) to be a boolean

**Transformation:**
- `trim` defaults to `true` — trims whitespace when enabled (applied before uppercase/lowercase)
- `uppercase` / `lowercase` — case-convert the (possibly trimmed) text
- `slug` — lowercases, trims, replaces runs of non-alphanumeric chars with a single hyphen, then strips edge hyphens (e.g. `' Hello, MCP! '` → `hello-mcp`, `---Hello,,,  World---` → `hello-world`)

The test suite passes (1/1), and manual edge-case checks confirmed correct behavior for slug edge cases, trim defaulting, and all rejection paths.
